title: Yellow Fluffy Norwegian Serrano Ham Frittata
description: A quick and easy Norwegian dish featuring serrano ham, perfect for a pescatarian friendly meal, this frittata is jammy and fluffy on the inside and golden on the outside, made with the help of sous vide for precise temperature control.
instructions: Preheat the sous vide machine to 160 degrees Fahrenheit.
Whisk the eggs in a bowl and season with salt and black pepper.
Add the diced serrano ham, grated cheese, and chopped parsley to the bowl and mix well.
Heat the butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and cook until the edges start to set.
Transfer the skillet to the sous vide machine and cook for 20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the sous vide machine and use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the frittata towards the center.
Return the skillet to the sous vide machine and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the sous vide machine and let it cool for a few minutes.
Slice the frittata into wedges and serve with a dollop of sour cream on top.
